improvements.description: Downstream derivation warnings must reduce accepted confidence in PM rollups, not only score display.
improvements.why_needed: Variant 1 score improved while governance quality risk increased due derivation warnings.
improvements.success_metric: Runs with downstream warnings auto-downgrade confidence tier even when score improves.

improvements.description: Add vendor-elimination regression guardrail with configurable minimum acceptable floor/delta.
improvements.why_needed: Variant 1 regressed VENDOR_ELIMINATION from 100.0 to 28.73 while overall score rose.
improvements.success_metric: Gate emits WARN/FAIL when vendor-elimination crosses configured regression threshold.

improvements.description: Add rule-impact attribution so score changes are linked to specific promoted rules.
improvements.why_needed: Current aggregate deltas do not distinguish beneficial rule effects from risky carryover effects.
improvements.success_metric: Per-run report includes rule-level positive/negative contribution mapping.

improvements.description: Implement hidden-target access audit that records pre-scoring target access violations.
improvements.why_needed: Hidden-target discipline is central to transfer experiment validity and must be automatically auditable.
improvements.success_metric: Verifier outputs PASS only when no forbidden LE target access occurs before scoring stage.

improvements.description: Add runtime-sensitive rule fail-closed checker tied to evidence artifact IDs.
improvements.why_needed: WCD9378 blockers must not silently transition without new hardware/runtime evidence.
improvements.success_metric: Any runtime-sensitive status relaxation without evidence ID produces verifier FAIL.

improvements.description: Add DTS-vs-schematic cross-check candidate schema for board-level evidence ingestion.
improvements.why_needed: DT normalization alone does not prove board wiring correctness for SoundWire/routing decisions.
improvements.success_metric: Evidence package can link DT node, schematic reference, and runtime log for each critical signal path.

improvements.description: Add LA/LE terminology consistency check in prompt templates and PM summaries.
improvements.why_needed: Consistent terminology reduces ambiguity in architecture/risk reasoning across family audits.
improvements.success_metric: Generated artifacts avoid mixed downstream/upstream naming drift and pass terminology lint.

improvements.description: Strengthen multi-file lineage coverage check with subsystem-level minimums (codec, SDW, header).
improvements.why_needed: Aggregate lineage can hide per-file gaps; family conversions need subsystem-granular observability.
improvements.success_metric: Gate report shows lineage coverage per converted file class and fails missing classes.

improvements.description: Provide an optional WCD family rule pack for conversion prompts (SoundWire, MBHC, Class-H, DAPM, anti-copy).
improvements.why_needed: Transfer experiment shows family-specific guidance improves quality when guarded against copy risk.
improvements.success_metric: Runs using rule pack improve quality without introducing verifier derivation warnings.
